create_vocoder_model: create a Vocoder model from a VocoderConfig with optional device and dtype
build_model_vocoder_builder: build a Vocoder model using VocoderBuilder with config, device, and dtype parameters
define_vocoder_config: define a VocoderConfig dataclass with upsample rates, kernel sizes, and embedding dimensions
register_vocoder_architecture: register a vocoder architecture variant using the vocoder_archs registry decorator
configure_base_vocoder: configure the base vocoder architecture with default upsample rates and resblock settings
